name: Houjou Natsue no Shiiku Fuukei
original_name: 北条奈津江の飼育風景
source:
Natsue Hojo, single mother to a son...... The beautiful, prematurely widowed milf who goes from tea house waitress to hentai whore slave of strange men!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE121510.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
北条夏江是一名单亲母亲……这个美丽、过早守寡的熟女，从茶馆女侍应变成了陌生男人的色情妓女奴隶！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE121510.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
